ops.quote: We build our model on top of the Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM)
learns to selectively focus on discriminative joints of skeleton within each frame of the inputs
pays different levels of attention to the outputs of different frames
we propose a regularized cross-entropy loss to drive the model learning process
